dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast white spots arranged in discrete horizontal rows across the dark coverts and flight feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Distinct white notches and spots along the boundaries of the folded primary and secondary feathers against a dark ground color.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, horizontal rectangular red patch located on the posterior crown/upper nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharply defined contrast between the black nape/neck and the broad white central mantle stripe.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, solid white longitudinal stripe extending down the center of the mantle.
